column1: # Every device we know of, as its platform describes it, and the edition of
# each model in models.json that it runs: models.json's fit and choose, as
# core/editions.c and pktito-app's editions.rs compute them, and both test
# suites read this file (tests/editioncheck here). A line is a description,
# the system (Rust's std::env::consts::OS), its version as major.minor
# (Android's SDK level, 0), QNN's name for its NPU (- for none), then an
# edition id for each model the header names, tab-separated.
an SM8845, which takes the S26's graph and never the X2's
an Android phone with no NPU
snappy (X1E, its QNN naming no SoC)
